opening: Here is a digest of the week's news on your topics.

topics.title: Test stellarator holds plasma for record 40 minutes
topics.summary: A research stellarator maintained a stable plasma for 40 minutes, four times its previous best, the lab said. Engineers credited a new tungsten wall coating that sheds less material into the plasma. Two outside physicists called it a real but incremental step, with net energy gain still years away.
topics.detail: The laboratory plans a campaign of one-hour runs at higher density in spring 2027, according to the French-language report. The record was set on Tuesday, October 13. The lab attributed the improvement to the tungsten wall coating reducing material shedding into the plasma.

sources.title: Test stellarator holds plasma for a record 40 minutes
Le stellarator d'essai bat son record de durée

topics.new_development: The seabed authority has scheduled a vote on a 10-year moratorium on commercial deep-sea mining for its November session, a concrete step beyond the resumed talks.
topics.title: Seabed authority schedules vote on mining moratorium
topics.summary: The council of an international seabed body agreed to vote on a 10-year moratorium on commercial deep-sea mining at its November session. Twelve member states back the pause, while two companies holding exploration contracts said a moratorium would breach existing agreements. The vote is set for 12 November and needs a two-thirds majority.
topics.detail: The published agenda puts the moratorium vote on 12 November, with a two-thirds majority required for passage. The council agreed to the vote on Monday, October 12. Two companies with exploration contracts argued that a moratorium would breach existing agreements.

sources.title: Seabed authority schedules a vote on a mining moratorium
Council agenda lists the moratorium for 12 November

topics.title: Chess federation to trial shorter youth time controls
topics.summary: A national chess federation will trial 45-minute games with a 10-second increment at three youth events this winter. The federation cited shorter attention spans and travel costs. Coaches quoted were split on the change.

sources.title: Chess federation tests a shorter time control for youth events

topics.title: Regional chess open draws record field of 900
topics.summary: A regional open tournament drew 900 players, its largest field since it began in 1998. Organizers added a second playing hall to accommodate the turnout.

sources.title: Regional chess open draws a record field of 900
